origin: A blend of glass and "-morphism". The name is credited to the designer Michał Malewicz around 2020.
whenToUse: Cards or menus floating over a colorful background.
Overlapping while showing a hint of the context behind.
Landing pages or widgets where atmosphere matters.
whenNotToUse: The background is too plain for the glass effect to show.
Text-heavy screens (contrast shifts with the background).
Services used on many low-end devices (blur is costly).

alternatives.name: Liquid Glass
alternatives.reason: Glass with reflections and refraction added.

alternatives.name: Flat Design
alternatives.reason: Planes with constant contrast regardless of background.

accessibility: Check text contrast at the brightest part of the background so it holds when the background changes.
For people with prefers-reduced-transparency, an opaque surface is recommended.
A border shows the card's edge.
States are also announced in words.
